**BOOK I — THE HOUSE OF MENDERS · Chapter 3 — The Undercroft · the hour bell and after, in fog, two days after the eve**

- **Where:** Saint Ysolde's, the House of Menders; on the end of his cot in the infirmary hall, the letters in his hand.
- **The quest:** *The List.* The Confessors have come for the Faithless at Saint Ysolde's with a list: Darrow first, Hollis second. The named are to be taken down the Steps to the Oathspire and made to kneel where everyone can watch, which would say the Ninth drowned for its own bad faith, and would tear the thread in Darrow's knee. What stands between them and the hall is Old Mercy, the sanctuary bell: while it rings at dawn and dusk, no blade passes the gate and no name under it is taken down against its will. Miss one ringing and the law lapses till the next, and Sister Pell, who rings it, is very old. At the gate, Confessor Ivo Marrant read his names at the bars, and two of his men came through the wicket before the bell rang, late. Now five grey cloaks are camped on the lower terrace below the gate, and the sixth holds the winch-house, the cage and Rae's cart, so the road is theirs. Marrant's price: the Captain of the Ninth comes down and kneels, and the rest of the paper goes back in his cloak. Darrow went to the bars and gave him his name and his face. Marrant says he will wait.
- **What Darrow is fighting right now:** The soft season, and the waiting. The knee is held and still soft. Benedek lies Hollowed in the Grey Cot, and nobody passed in the night; the Confessor's word for it, ember witchcraft, is in the hall now, and the hall wants a hand to fit it. Under it is the thing he has said only to Maelis: a lad who cannot answer has no will for the bell to keep.
- **Just happened (Scene):** *Blue Wax.* He turned the smaller sheet over in his fingers. Or I will come myself. Aldric had never once said a thing like that and not done it.
- **With him:** Maelis Vorne (At the far cots. She has told the Captain his answer is right and not yet true, and to ask her again tomorrow.) · Ser Hollis Garrow (At the Grey Cot with the lad's hand.) · Wren Ashdown (At the foot of the Captain's cot with her ledger shut.)
- **Also here:** Ser Aldric Vane (Wrote again from Calden, before the list was read: Calden says the Ninth broke faith when its captain turned out of the line for one of his…) · Ser Benedek Orrin (Lay Hollowed in the Grey Cot; his lips did not move at the bell; the Captain said his oath aloud for him.) · Confessor Ivo Marrant (Came up to the bars alone in the fog at the hour bell, asked for the Captain by rank, and handed him two letters in blue wax from Aldric, b…) · Mother Ione (At the undercroft door, told the Captain to come and tell her what he would do at the bottom when the Mender tells him yes.) · Sister Pell (Rang the hours through the night and came down between every bell to sit by the undercroft door; heard nothing come or go; told Hollis she…)
- **The tales:** Tale 1 — Quickstep (1 of 3 told)
- **Against him:** Aldric knew where he lay before the list and says he will come himself; something below the hall draws on it every night.
- **Next:** What he does with Aldric's letters; then the stair.
- **Open choice:** none.
